subject: code/check_profile_registry.py
note: each defect must be refused by the comparison named for it. D5 is the load-bearing one: an unreachable registry must report `unmeasured`, never agreement

D1_a_registered_profile_nobody_implement.why: a renderer told a profile exists would ask for a verdict no code can produce

D2_an_implemented_profile_nobody_registe.why: a rule with no registered reason is a rule nobody agreed to; the registry exists so a profile cannot appear without one

D3_registry_satisfaction_drifted_from_th.why: the registry is built from that log; drift means one was regenerated without the other and the registry now describes a state that does not hold

D4_a_measured_line_missing_from_the_regi.why: a line the registry has never heard of is not a governed line

D5_no_registry_reachable_is_unmeasured_n.why: a check that cannot run has no verdict; reporting agreement there is worse than not checking at all

C1_the_healthy_registry_agrees.why: the real state must pass, or the drill above proves nothing

C2_status_and_prose_are_the_registry_s_t.why: this check owns the SET of profiles, not their lifecycle or wording; over-reaching would make the registry unable to govern the thing it was moved out to govern

C3_an_absent_measurement_is_reported_not.why: with nothing to compare against, the answer is 'not comparable', which the caller treats as failure rather than silently as agreement

detail.why: no archived cross-branch measurement to compare against
